name: Trench War
author: Addicting Games
description: Trench War is a free mobile war game. Our world is at trench war, now and forever. In Trench Wars you won't just choose a side you'll run it. Trench Wars is not a simple game for simple people but rather an epic and intense game of global conflict that will ensare the lives of countless thousands. Choose your side, stake out a place on the map and then build your army, summon your units, direct your soldiers, engage the enemy, hunker down in a bunker or get up and charge your way into history. Trench Wars is a game which rewards strategy and slowly bidding your time as well as lightning fast attacks and blitzes into the enemies encampments. In battle, you might need to use tactical logic to ascertain the most optimal form of combat be it snipers, machine gunners, riflemen, or a bombing run but long term this game will be won by generals who know how to plan, pivot and push forward. The more time you invest in learning the nuance of Trench Wars the more you are likely to get out of it.
